points.title: 学徒岁月
points.description: 本杰明·富兰克林1706年1月17日出生于波士顿，是家中第十个孩子。他仅接受过两年正规教育，12岁时便在哥哥詹姆斯的印刷厂当学徒。在这里，他掌握了印刷技术，并通过大量阅读自学成才。1721年，他开始匿名为哥哥的《新英格兰报》撰稿，展示了他早期的写作才华。这段经历培养了他对印刷业的深刻理解和独立思考的能力，为他后来的事业奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Benjamin Franklin was born on January 17, 1706, in Boston, the tenth of seventeen children. With only two years of formal education, he became an apprentice to his brother James at a printing shop at age 12. There, he mastered the printing trade and educated himself through extensive reading. In 1721, he began anonymously contributing articles to his brother's newspaper, The New England Courant, showcasing his early writing talent. This period instilled in him a deep understanding of the printing business and independent thinking, laying the foundation for his future career.

points.title: 创业崛起
points.description: 1723年，17岁的富兰克林逃离波士顿，来到费城寻求发展。他最初在凯默印刷厂工作，很快凭借才华获得认可。1729年，他买下了《宾夕法尼亚公报》，并将其发展成北美最成功的报纸之一。在此期间，他创建了北美第一个公共图书馆（费城图书馆公司），并开始参与公共事务。1730年，他与黛博拉·里德结婚，建立了家庭。这一时期，富兰克林不仅积累了财富，还培养了广泛的社交网络和公共影响力，为他后来的政治生涯奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1723, at age 17, Franklin fled Boston to seek opportunities in Philadelphia. He initially worked at Keimer's printing house but quickly gained recognition for his talents. In 1729, he purchased The Pennsylvania Gazette and developed it into one of the most successful newspapers in North America. During this time, he established the Library Company of Philadelphia, the first public library in North America, and began engaging in public affairs. In 1730, he married Deborah Read and established a family. This period not only allowed Franklin to accumulate wealth but also cultivate extensive social networks and public influence, laying the groundwork for his later political career.

points.title: 公民领袖
points.description: 这一时期，富兰克林积极参与费城的公共事务和社会改革。他创建了北美第一个消防队、美国哲学学会和宾夕法尼亚大学。1743年，他提出了建立学院的想法，后来发展成为宾夕法尼亚大学。1749年，他起草了《宾夕法尼亚贫民院计划》，为穷人提供教育和就业机会。他还进行了著名的电学实验，证明了闪电是电的一种形式，并发明了避雷针。1751年，他被任命为宾夕法尼亚州议会议员，正式步入政坛。这一阶段，富兰克林展现了卓越的组织能力和创新精神，成为殖民地最具影响力的公民领袖之一。
points.descriptionEn: During this period, Franklin actively participated in Philadelphia's public affairs and social reforms. He founded the first volunteer fire company in North America, the American Philosophical Society, and the University of Pennsylvania. In 1743, he proposed the idea of establishing an academy that later became the University of Pennsylvania. In 1749, he drafted the Pennsylvania Hospital Plan, providing education and employment opportunities for the poor. He also conducted his famous electrical experiments, proving that lightning is a form of electricity, and invented the lightning rod. In 1751, he was appointed to the Pennsylvania Assembly, officially entering politics. This phase demonstrated Franklin's exceptional organizational skills and innovative spirit, establishing him as one of the most influential civic leaders in the colonies.

points.title: 外交使节
points.description: 1757年，富兰克林作为宾夕法尼亚的代表首次前往伦敦，处理殖民地与英国之间的争端。他在伦敦生活了将近16年，期间多次往返于英美之间。1765年，他反对《印花税法》，并代表殖民地向英国议会请愿。1766年，他向英国下议院作证，反对该税法，最终促使该法被废除。1774年，波士顿倾茶事件后，他被指控为叛乱分子，其私人信件被公开，导致他与英国彻底决裂。1775年，他返回美国，正式投身独立革命。在伦敦的岁月使富兰克林成为熟悉英国政治的专家，培养了他作为外交家的敏锐洞察力和谈判技巧。
points.descriptionEn: In 1757, Franklin traveled to London for the first time as Pennsylvania's representative to handle disputes between the colonies and Great Britain. He lived in London for nearly 16 years, making multiple trips between America and Britain. In 1765, he opposed the Stamp Act and petitioned the British Parliament on behalf of the colonies. In 1766, he testified before the House of Commons against the act, ultimately contributing to its repeal. After the Boston Tea Party in 1774, he was accused of sedition, and his private letters were published, leading to his complete break with Britain. In 1775, he returned to America and formally joined the Revolutionary War. His years in London made Franklin an expert in British politics and developed his keen diplomatic insight and negotiation skills.

points.title: 建国元勋
points.description: 1776年，富兰克林作为五人委员会成员参与起草《独立宣言》，并成为宣言的主要签署者之一。1777年，他被派往法国，成功争取法国对美国独立战争的支持。1785年，他返回美国，被选为宾夕法尼亚州总统（州长）。1787年，作为最年长的代表，他参加了制宪会议，并提出了著名的'日晷妥协'，帮助解决了大州与小州之间的代表权争议。他还签署了美国宪法。1789年，华盛顿当选总统后，富兰克林当选为宾夕法尼亚州废除奴隶制协会主席。1790年4月17日，富兰克林在费城逝世，享年84岁。作为美国开国元勋，他的政治智慧和外交成就对美国独立和建国产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1776, Franklin served on the five-member committee that drafted the Declaration of Independence and became one of its principal signers. In 1777, he was sent to France, where he successfully secured French support for the American Revolutionary War. In 1785, he returned to America and was elected President (Governor) of Pennsylvania. In 1787, as the oldest delegate, he participated in the Constitutional Convention and proposed the famous 'Great Compromise,' helping resolve the dispute between large and small states over representation. He also signed the U.S. Constitution. In 1789, after Washington's election as president, Franklin was elected president of the Pennsylvania Society for Promoting the Abolition of Slavery. On April 17, 1790, Franklin died in Philadelphia at age 84. As a Founding Father of the United States, his political wisdom and diplomatic achievements had a profound impact on American independence and nation-building.

supporter.zh: 富兰克林被视为美国精神的象征，体现了自力更生、实用主义和公共服务的价值观。作为科学家、发明家、作家、印刷商、政治家和外交家，他展现了多方面的才能。他的发明如避雷针、双光眼镜和富兰克林炉改善了无数人的生活。他创建的公共图书馆、消防队和大学等机构奠定了美国公民社会的基础。作为外交家，他成功争取法国支持，对美国独立战争胜利至关重要。富兰克林的一生体现了通过勤奋、智慧和公共服务实现自我提升的美国梦。
supporter.en: Franklin is regarded as a symbol of the American spirit, embodying the values of self-reliance, pragmatism, and public service. As a scientist, inventor, writer, printer, politician, and diplomat, he demonstrated multifaceted talents. His inventions such as the lightning rod, bifocal glasses, and Franklin stove improved countless lives. The institutions he founded, including public libraries, fire departments, and universities, laid the foundation of American civil society. As a diplomat, he successfully secured French support, which was crucial to the victory of the American Revolutionary War. Franklin's life exemplifies the American Dream of achieving self-improvement through diligence, wisdom, and public service.

critic.zh: 批评者指出富兰克林存在明显的道德矛盾。虽然他倡导废除奴隶制，却一生拥有奴隶，直到晚年才真正采取行动反对奴隶制。作为印刷商，他有时会出于商业利益而发表有争议的内容。他的家庭生活也有争议，特别是他与私生子威廉的关系，威廉作为效忠派在美国独立战争中与父亲对立。此外，富兰克林的实用主义有时被视为机会主义，他在独立问题上的立场转变被一些人批评为政治投机。这些批评反映了富兰克林作为历史人物的复杂性和时代局限性。
critic.en: Critics point out significant moral contradictions in Franklin's life. Although he advocated for the abolition of slavery, he owned slaves himself until taking concrete action against it late in life. As a printer, he sometimes published controversial content for commercial gain. His family life also faced criticism, particularly his relationship with his illegitimate son William, who sided with the Loyalists against his father during the American Revolution. Additionally, Franklin's pragmatism has been viewed by some as opportunism, and his shifting stance on independence has been criticized as political expediency. These criticisms reflect the complexity and limitations of Franklin as a historical figure within his time.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，富兰克林被塑造为'万能人'的典范，体现了启蒙时代的理性精神和实用主义。他的形象超越了单纯的爱国者或科学家，成为美国文化中代表智慧、实用创新和公民美德的象征。流行文化常将他描绘为百元美钞上的严肃长者，但历史学家更强调他的全球视野和跨文化影响力。作为连接美国与欧洲知识分子的桥梁，他的科学成就和外交贡献被重新评估。现代学者更关注他作为社会改革者和公民活动家的角色，以及他在塑造美国公共领域方面的贡献，这些方面使他在当代民主社会中仍然具有相关性。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Franklin is portrayed as the archetype of the 'Renaissance man,' embodying the rational spirit and pragmatism of the Enlightenment. His image transcends that of a mere patriot or scientist, becoming a symbol of wisdom, practical innovation, and civic virtue in American culture. Popular culture often depicts him as the stern elder on the hundred-dollar bill, but historians emphasize his global perspective and cross-cultural influence. As a bridge between American and European intellectuals, his scientific achievements and diplomatic contributions have been reassessed. Modern scholars focus more on his role as a social reformer and civic activist, as well as his contributions to shaping the American public sphere, aspects that maintain his relevance in contemporary democratic societies.

self.zh: 投资于知识的人，将获得最好的回报。
self.en: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.

others.zh: 富兰克林是第一位伟大的美国人，他集美国人所有特质于一身。
others.en: Franklin was the first great American, he contained all the traits of Americans.
